rules.ambiguousTaxonomicOnlyPolicy: taxonomic-only class names require manual review before adult-ant inclusion.
rules.broodPolicy: brood boxes are metadata/negative context only and must not be remapped automatically to ant.
rules.formicaiAdultAntMappingCandidate: queen_* and worker_* classes can be considered adult ant candidates; brood remains NOT ant.

visualFindings: Many adult boxes localize the ant well but include more legs/antennae/padding than FormicAI tight-body boxes.
Large queen and single-ant closeups are useful for the ant2 scale gap, but several look like broad species-identification crops.
Crowded colony/nest frames usually use one box per visible individual, but manual review is needed before remapping.
Brood boxes are present and often co-occur with adults; brood must remain NOT-ant under FormicAI policy.

bboxScale.interpretation: AntsNet adult boxes span small through large scales; compare p50/p75/p90 directly before treating as tight-body compatible.

broodHardNegativeAudit.recommendation: Do not convert brood labels automatically. Use brood-containing images only after manual FormicAI adult-ant labeling/negative-region review.

duplicatesAndAugmentation.finding: Roboflow version metadata reports no augmentations. Exact hashes detect exact duplicates only; perceptual hash/family groups indicate repeated/near-duplicate photo series that should not be split blindly.

doNotUseDirectlyFor: hard negatives from brood boxes without manual policy review
proposedUseInV3.role: candidate public source for manual FormicAI tight-body relabeling and scale/domain diversity, not a direct label import
usefulSignals: brood-adult context for negative-context policy review
artificial nest, tube, gravel, substrate, and colony-scene variation

provenanceDomainAudit.availableMetadata: Public Roboflow export identifies provider AntsNet.org and MIT license; no per-image photographer/site/source URLs were present in the YOLOv8 export.
provenanceDomainAudit.finding: Species/caste diversity is real at label-taxonomy level, but independent provenance is not established by the export. Treat repeated filename families and same-species series as potential leakage groups.
